inputs.text: Full-length figure from head to feet: a towering tusked rakshasa warrior, dark bronze skin, heavy dented war armour, holding a long spear, a war drum strapped to his back, fierce scowl. Exactly two arms, a bare head with only the plain grey backdrop directly behind it. Hades-style painterly cel-shaded game character art with bold dark ink outlines, hand-painted textures, saturated vivid colours and strong coloured rim lighting, with Indian miniature-painting ornament: fine gold-leaf detail and flat patterned colour fields on the clothing and armour, crisp black contour lines. Three-quarter top-down game sprite view, a single character, the entire figure visible from head to feet, standing on a plain flat light-grey background that fills the rest of the image.
